title: Nvidia Built an AI Security Alliance Without OpenAI
description:
Nvidia quietly pulled 27 companies into one AI security alliance 🔥 Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, Dell and Hugging Face are in, OpenAI Google and Anthropic said no. The trigger: an AI agent made 17,000 moves inside Hugging Face and comercial closed tools missed it. Only an open model caught the thing 😅 Now they want goverments to treat open models as defense, not risk ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
